reconstructionStatus.kind: evidence-constrained approximate replay, not unique metric 6-DoF recovery
reconstructionStatus.metricScale: HUD-based22m ramp-height prior chooses otherwise ambiguous global scale
reconstructionStatus.airPosition: registered main-view silhouette fit conditional on world z=0
reconstructionStatus.airOrientation: inferred eased quaternion interpolation between inversion and wheels-down endpoints
reconstructionStatus.thrusters: authored0–1 visual envelopes from observed plume phases; not force measurements
reconstructionStatus.editedReplayTiming: fitted affine nuisance parameter on air window only; early-climb mismatch retained

car.origin: midpoint of four nominal tire-contact points; ground y=0
car.dimensionsStatus: measured from length-normalized generated Tripo model; not surveyed vehicle

ramp.construction: elliptical half-loop followed by tangent overhang
ramp.fitStatus: regularized two-view inverse-rendered geometry; not survey

uncertainty.kind: plausible modeling ranges, not statistical confidence intervals

depthPlaneSensitivity.method: same observed pixel ray, varying assumed root z plane; conditional on fitted camera

validation.carCenterRmsMeaning: in-sample 2D fit consistency; not independent metric 3D accuracy
validation.contactErrorMeaning: distance to delivered fitted-deck polyline for assumed wheelbase; excludes physical tire/deck uncertainty

motion.status: regularized replay kinematics; no force or vehicle capability measurement

sync.status: joint fitted camera/timing calibration; not hardware synchronization
